---
title: "Project workflow"
---

This Quarto book is the reproducible analysis record for the prenatal chronic noise exposure meta-analysis.

The workflow follows the protocol (`protocol/PCNE_protocol_v.4_111425.docx`, with the deviation addendum of 18 August 2026):

1. finish preparing the extraction database for analysis (Chapter 1);
2. calculate the log response ratio, lnRR (Chapter 2);
3. estimate the overall effect of maternal chronic noise exposure on offspring anxiety- and depression-like behaviour (Chapter 3);
4. fit uni-moderator models for the biological and methodological moderators listed in the protocol (Chapter 4);
5. assess publication bias (Chapter 5);
6. report the CRIME-Q critical appraisal of the included studies (Chapter 6).

This analysis is scoped to lnRR only - no lnVR or lnCVR - and to uni-moderator models, matching the plan agreed for this project. Reproducible outputs are written to `Data/derived/` and `Data/audits/`; the reviewed extraction file in `outputs/019ff719-4f39-7b31-8dee-189f2b3ff628/` is never overwritten.

## How to render this book

Open `pcne_book` in RStudio (or run `quarto render` from within this folder) after installing the packages listed in each chapter's setup step. `orchaRd` is installed from GitHub (`daniel1noble/orchaRd`) the first time a chapter that needs it is rendered.
